body:
## Overview

The compiler writes headings of its own: one for each group, and one for each document a group does not merge. This task settles a single title-casing convention over all of them, so a generated heading reads the same whichever construction emitted it.

## Problem

The same bundle carries generated headings in two spellings.

- **A group heading is title-cased and a document heading is not.**
  One run emits `# Rules` beside `# procedure`, `# tips` and `# rules/codex`.
- **The convention exists but reaches one construction.**
  The [group heading](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/blob/7ba5fe9f44ade4a19b843619aeea37abf2c7f4b1/src/prosiform/grouping.py) applies title casing to the name it carries; the [document heading](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/blob/7ba5fe9f44ade4a19b843619aeea37abf2c7f4b1/src/prosiform/bundle.py) emits the path it derived.
- **The documentation reproduces it.**
  The rendered diagrams carry both spellings, so the mixed output reads as the intended output.

## Proposal

- **One convention covers every generated heading.**
  The title casing a group heading already takes reaches the document arrangement and every other heading the compiler writes: `procedure` becomes `Procedure`, `tips` becomes `Tips`, and `rules/codex` becomes `Rules/Codex`. Path structure survives the casing.

- **The casing reaches what the compiler wrote, and nothing else.**
  A heading an author wrote keeps the author's spelling, and a filesystem path a run names keeps the spelling on disk. Source paths and the folder a grouping rule names are unchanged by it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every heading the bundle generates carries one title-casing convention, nested paths and hyphenated names included, as the grouping tests and the corpus fixtures show.
- [ ] **AC2.** A heading a source authored and a filesystem path a run names carry the spelling their source wrote, as the preservation fixtures show.

## References

- **R1.** [Planning record](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/tree/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-10-17-prosiform-v1) — the design this task revises and the work item for its row.
- **R2.** [Invocation guide](https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/blob/7ba5fe9f44ade4a19b843619aeea37abf2c7f4b1/invocation.md) — the documented bundling rules the generated headings answer to.
title: [I01:E02:W04] Generated Headings: One Title Case for Every Bundle Heading
